recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast portrait of a female vocalist positioned on the left, set against a dramatic dark sky filled with electric pink and white lightning bolts. The right side is dominated by bold, multi-layered typography featuring heavy drop shadows and vibrant gradients.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject looking back over shoulder toward the viewer
Lightning bolts radiating from behind the subject's head
Text stacked vertically on the right to balance the subject's mass
Starburst graphic in the lower right corner acting as a secondary focal point
coreInvariants: Electric lightning texture in the background
Heavy black drop shadows on all display text
High-contrast lighting on the subject's face
Ornate, patterned clothing on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, shown from the waist up, angled away from the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large, bright title text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the lightning bolts to the top-right text, moves down through the title, and ends at the starburst sticker.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with lightning patterns and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark purple in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Electric pink and white for the lightning and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan, yellow, and orange gradients within the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text gradients against a dark, high-value contrast background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy sans-serif and casual script hybrids
letterConstructionRules: Thick black outlines and deep offset drop shadows
Tight letter spacing with slight overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: Quotation marks styled as thick, slanted bars
Stacked layout with varying font sizes for hierarchy
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script-style display for the artist name paired with a blocky, high-impact sans-serif for the title and callouts.

candidateDirections.reason: For the bold, blocky title and starburst text.
For the casual, energetic feel of the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman in a patterned black dress with gold embroidery, looking over her shoulder. The background should be a dark, stormy sky with vibrant pink and white lightning bolts striking across the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, stacked typography on the right side. Use a cyan-to-white gradient for the top text and a yellow-to-red gradient for the middle text, both with heavy black drop shadows. Place a bright yellow multi-pointed starburst in the bottom right corner with black sans-serif text inside.

verificationChecks: Is the lightning vibrant and high-contrast?
Do the text gradients flow vertically?
Is the drop shadow deep and solid black?
Is the subject's pose dynamic and looking toward the viewer?

adjustableVariables: Pattern density on the subject's clothing
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the starburst is a solid, bright yellow.
Verify the lightning bolts have a glowing effect.
Confirm the drop shadows are consistent in direction.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait on left + Lightning background + Stacked gradient text on right + Starburst callout = Retro Soul Cover
